result.stdout:
Usage: ids [options]

Cross-platform identifier generator — UUID v4, UUID v7, ULID, NanoID.

Options:
  -u, --uppercase              Uppercase UUID hex output
  -t, --type TYPE              Identifier type: uuid4, uuid7, ulid, nanoid (default: uuid7)
  -n, --count N                Number of IDs to generate (default: 1)
  -l, --length N               NanoID length (default: 21, nanoid only)
  --alphabet ALPHA             NanoID alphabet: url-safe, alphanum, hex, lower, upper (nanoid only)
  --format FORMAT              UUID shape: default, hex, braces, urn (uuid only)
  -h, --help                   Show help
  --version                    Show version
  --no-color                   Disable colored output
  --json                       JSON output
  --describe                   Structured JSON metadata for AI agents
  --color[=auto|always|never]  Coloured output: auto (default when omitted), always, or never

Examples:
  ids                                           Generate one UUID v7 (default)
  ids --type ulid --count 100                   100 time-ordered ULIDs, one per line
  ids --type nanoid --length 12                 A 12-char URL-safe NanoID
  ids --type uuid7 --format braces --uppercase  Windows-registry-style braced uppercase GUID
  ids --type nanoid --alphabet hex --length 16  Short random hex token
  ids --count 5 --json                          Five UUID v7 IDs as a JSON array

Composes with:
  ids | clip                                                    Generate an ID and copy it to the clipboard
  ids --type nanoid --count 5 | xargs -I{} curl http://host/{}  Feed generated IDs into another command

Exit Codes:
  0    Success
  1    Unexpected runtime error (e.g. OS CSPRNG failure, OOM)
  125  Usage error: bad flags, unknown value, or flag/type mismatch
